data.one_liner: Realistic 3D page-flipping widget for Flutter with smooth hardware-accelerated animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-performance 3D page-flipping widget with native render box support for digital books, magazines, catalogs, and PDFs. It features gesture harmony, pinch-to-zoom, configurable shadows, paper boundary styles, and RTL reading direction.
use_when: You need a realistic book or magazine page-flipping effect in your app.
You want to render and flip through PDF documents with hardware acceleration.
You require interactive widgets (buttons, text fields) inside pages without bitmap conversion.
avoid_when: You only need standard linear scrolling lists or simple tab views.
Your application requires a license model other than the Turnable Page Proprietary License.
strengths: Hardware-accelerated 60fps animations using native RenderBox and compositing pipeline.
Supports fully interactive widgets directly inside pages without bitmap bottlenecks.
Includes built-in PDF viewer support and pinch-to-zoom capabilities.
weaknesses: Uses a proprietary license (TPPL) rather than a standard open source license.
Limited to page-turning book or catalog metaphors.
data.setup_notes: Call TurnablePdf.initPDFLoaders() in main() if using PDF features.
